name: Malaria
cause: Spread through bites of infected Anopheles mosquitoes.
treatment: Seek medical attention immediately. Malaria is treatable with antimalarial drugs. Do not self-medicate.
prevention: Use mosquito nets, indoor spraying, and remove stagnant water around the home.

name: Cholera
cause: Caused by contaminated water or food.
treatment: Rehydrate immediately using ORS and seek urgent medical care.
prevention: Drink safe water, wash hands, cook food thoroughly, practice good hygiene.

name: Typhoid Fever
cause: Bacteria spread through contaminated food or water.
treatment: Requires antibiotics. Visit a clinic as soon as possible.
prevention: Wash hands, boil drinking water, avoid uncooked foods.

name: Tuberculosis (TB)
cause: Airborne bacteria spread when infected people cough or sneeze.
treatment: Six-month antibiotic treatment at registered TB centers.
prevention: Good ventilation, early screening, adherence to TB treatment.

name: Common Cold
cause: Caused by viral infections spread through droplets.
treatment: Rest, fluids, warm drinks, pain relievers.
prevention: Wash hands frequently and avoid touching your face.

name: COVID-19
cause: Respiratory virus spread through droplets and surfaces.
treatment: Isolate, hydrate, and seek care for breathing difficulty.
prevention: Vaccination, masks, hand washing.

name: HIV/AIDS
cause: Virus spread through blood, sexual contact, and childbirth.
treatment: Antiretroviral therapy (ART). Available for free at clinics.
prevention: Safe sex, HIV testing, avoid sharing needles.

name: Pneumonia
cause: Bacterial or viral infection of the lungs.
treatment: Requires antibiotics or antiviral treatment at a clinic.
prevention: Vaccination, avoiding smoke, prompt treatment of colds.

name: Asthma
cause: Inflammation of the airways triggered by dust, smoke, or cold air.
treatment: Use inhalers as prescribed. Seek care during severe attacks.
prevention: Avoid triggers such as dust, smoke, or allergens.

name: Hypertension
cause: High blood pressure due to lifestyle, stress, or genetics.
treatment: Lifestyle changes and medication at a clinic.
prevention: Healthy diet, reduced salt, exercise.

name: Diabetes
cause: Body cannot regulate blood sugar properly.
treatment: Diet changes, medication, and regular checkups.
prevention: Healthy eating and exercise.

name: Dysentery
cause: Bacterial or amoebic infection through contaminated food or water.
treatment: ORS for hydration and antibiotics at a clinic.
prevention: Boil water and maintain good hygiene.

name: Anaemia
cause: Low red blood cells due to iron deficiency or chronic illness.
treatment: Iron supplements and diet changes.
prevention: Iron-rich foods like beans, meat, and leafy vegetables.

name: Bilharzia (Schistosomiasis)
cause: Parasites from contaminated freshwater streams.
treatment: Praziquantel medication at clinics.
prevention: Avoid swimming in contaminated water.

name: Measles
cause: Highly contagious virus spread through droplets.
treatment: Supportive care; vitamin A supplementation.
prevention: Measles vaccination.

name: Influenza (Flu)
cause: Viral infection spread through droplets.
treatment: Rest, fluids, painkillers.
prevention: Hand washing and avoiding close contact.

name: Food Poisoning
cause: Eating contaminated or spoiled food.
treatment: Hydrate and seek care if symptoms worsen.
prevention: Proper food hygiene.

name: Ringworm
cause: Fungal infection spread through contact.
treatment: Antifungal creams or tablets.
prevention: Keep skin dry, avoid sharing personal items.

name: Conjunctivitis (Pink Eye)
cause: Viral or bacterial infection of the eye.
treatment: Clean eyes with warm water; seek care for severe symptoms.
prevention: Avoid touching eyes and sharing towels.

name: UTI (Urinary Tract Infection)
cause: Bacterial infection of the urinary tract.
treatment: Antibiotics from a clinic.
prevention: Drink plenty of water and maintain good hygiene.
